component.name: COSMIC YubiKey Manager
component.summary: YubiKey FIDO2 and Biometric PAM Authentication Manager for COSMIC

description.p: COSMIC YubiKey Manager is a native Rust utility designed specifically for Pop!_OS COSMIC desktop. It enables robust hardware-backed FIDO2 and biometric (YubiKey C Bio) authentication for both the COSMIC Lockscreen/Greeter and sudo command execution.

ul.li: Native COSMIC Panel Status Applet with real-time hardware connection monitoring
Instant biometric unlock on lockscreen (with Space+Enter activation to eliminate greeter lag)
Passwordless or touch-confirmed sudo privilege escalation
One-click biometric sensor testing and diagnostic notifications
Full automated setup, key enrollment, and clean uninstallation

description.p: Initial release with COSMIC Greeter support, YubiKey C Bio hardware user verification, and StatusNotifierItem desktop panel applet.
